description: This file defines a base class 'TransactionBase' for handling transaction-related operations in ERPNext, including validation, calendar event management, reference validation, and UOM (Unit of Measure) checks.

classes.name: UOMMustBeIntegerError
classes.description: Custom validation error for UOM quantity validation.

classes.name: TransactionBase
classes.description: Base class providing transaction validation, calendar event management, reference validation, and UOM validation functionalities.

methods.name: validate_posting_time
methods.description: Validates and sets the posting date and time, especially during data import.

methods.name: add_calendar_event
methods.description: Adds a calendar event if contact details or end date have changed.

methods.name: delete_events
methods.description: Deletes events linked to a specific reference type and name.

methods.name: _add_calendar_event
methods.description: Internal method to create and insert a new calendar event.

methods.name: validate_uom_is_integer
methods.description: Validates that UOM quantities are whole numbers if required.

methods.name: validate_with_previous_doc
methods.description: Validates the current document against a previous document for duplicate or inconsistent data.

methods.name: compare_values
methods.description: Compares field values between documents for validation.

methods.name: validate_rate_with_reference_doc
methods.description: Ensures item rates match reference documents, with configurable actions on mismatch.

methods.name: get_link_filters
methods.description: Generates filters for linked documents based on current document items.

methods.name: reset_default_field_value
methods.description: Resets default form fields if child table values are inconsistent.
